title.narrative: Resilient and Nutrition Sensitive Agricultural Program

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to promote food and nutrition security and food systems resilience in Nyaruguru, Gatsibo and Gakenke districts. This will be achieved through two specific objectives/outcomes;

Outcome 1: Increased food production and incomes through inclusive and sustainable management of agroecosystems,

Outcome 2: Enhanced nutrition and dietary intake among malnourished children under 5 years and pregnant and lactating women.

The following outputs will contribute to the achievement of the above objectives;

Output 1.1: Strengthened capacity of smallholder farmers to adopt climate-resilient agricultural practices,

Output 1.2: Increased availability and access to quality agricultural inputs,

Output 1.3: The capacities of farmers on post-harvest handling practices, smallholder aggregation and livelihood diversification are enhanced,

Output 2.1: Appropriate maternal, infant, and young child nutrition (MIYCN) and water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) practices at household level are promoted,

Output 2.2: Strengthen district nutrition and WASH coordination mechanisms.
